interface_registry.source: Read-only Windows Enum device-parameters query for the unique present041f:d002 Billboard; no USB request.
interface_registry.limit: Existing OS registry metadata; no firmware-build identity or vendor-command compatibility established.

interface_reference.matching_reference: The Griffin Creek extended-properties descriptor publishes this exact GUID.
interface_reference.counterexample: Independent Bridgetek USB SDK header uses the same GUID as an extended-property example. It is not a unique Infineon protocol or silicon identifier.
interface_reference.application_dispatch: Griffin Creek main.c registers vendor_req_handler. That calls Cy_App_Dmc_VendorRequestHandler only under CY_APP_DMC_PHASE1_UPDATE_ENABLE. The complete selected command-handler implementation and DEG2 build options remain unqualified.
interface_reference.fallback_dispatch: The app-common wrapper calls the application handler first; optional flash-log handling is a later conditional fallback. A header enum does not prove the actual handler runs.
interface_reference.status_content: The already pinned D6/D7 header describes dock/component image status, versions and identity. Those payloads are not themselves a PD packet transcript or a retimer training register read.
interface_reference.result: WinUSB transport exists, but this fingerprint does not qualify a D6/D7/DE request for DEG2. No vendor request was issued.

descriptor_reference.template_rule: bb_update_bos_descriptor copies a configured BOS template first when that configuration is present.
descriptor_reference.overwrite_rule: It overwrites the mode word with software-held EUDO only when BILLBOARD_1_2_2_SUPPORT is built and usb4Supp is true.
descriptor_reference.ordering_rule: Cy_PdAltMode_Usb4_UpdateDataStatus stores altModeAppStatus.eudo before calling HW_SetMux and returning the mux result.
consequences: A nonzero template/reported word is not proof of a captured Enter_USB packet.
Even a copied saved EUDO does not certify successful mux programming.
Zero versus nonzero across saved captures cannot by itself distinguish no request, rejection, reset or a later failed route.
descriptor_reference.applicability: Reference implementation only. DEG2 source/build identity and writer of its observed word are not proven.

bios_setter.selected_usb_field: Selector0x0e writes PBS4d, the separate PD Thunderbolt3 Alt Mode setting. It is not the still-unlocated PBS9c consumer.
bios_setter.other_effect: The same routine also updates bit4 of one fixed MMIO byte and writes two separate Setup buffers. No meaning is assigned to that MMIO byte here.
bios_setter.failure_order: The PBS SetVariable occurs before later reads and writes, with early returns on some later failed reads; this is not an atomic USB4-only operation with an established rollback.
bios_setter.availability: Registered boot-service firmware protocol function. No qualified Windows runtime caller or port-only reapply path has been established.
bios_setter.result: Do not use this broad settings routine as the next USB4 test. It was not invoked.
